title: Pi Digits Catalogue row schema (v1)
description: One chain-verified self-validating row in the srmech pi_digits catalog. Each row encodes an input (num_digits) and the ground-truth output (expected_pi_string) of the named operator chain. CI runs the chain `pi_cascade_digits` and bit-exact-compares the produced output to the stored expected output. Per `[[feedback_every_doc_edit_faces_falsification]]` (2026-05-16) — the canonical mechanism by which project doc claims are falsified or validated via class-operator chain composition. Per `[[user_stance_pi_spectral_shape_scalar_invariant]]` — π's substrate identity is the cascade-emergent CF-convergent ladder; the decimal expansion stored here is a downstream readout.

row_label.description: Human-readable identifier for the row, e.g. 'pi_15_digits'.

row_type.description: Taxonomy of the chain operation. Initially only 'cascade_decimal_expansion' (rc12); future rcs may add 'cf_convergent_ladder' for explicit convergent ladders, etc.

num_digits.description: Number of decimal digits to emit after the decimal point. The chain `pi_cascade_digits` is parameterised by this single integer. rc12 cap was 50; rc13 raises to 1000 with auto-scaled cascade depth + precision_bits per Task #248 (engineering follow-on to PR #468 benchmark finding).

expected_pi_string.description: Ground-truth decimal expansion of π as a string starting with '3.' (so 'pi_15_digits' has expected_pi_string '3.141592653589793'). Verifiable against Khinchin *Continued Fractions* §10 or any standard π table.

chain_id.description: Name of the operator chain in this catalog's descriptor.toml that produced the expected output.

source_khinchin.description: Khinchin *Continued Fractions* reference for the canonical π CF expansion (used by `continued_fraction_convergents`).

source_hardy_wright.description: Hardy & Wright *Theory of Numbers* reference for the best-rational property of CF convergents.

source_archimedes.description: Archimedes *Measurement of a Circle* (c. 250 BCE) — historical anchor for the hexagon-doubling cascade algorithm.

source_published_date.description: ISO 8601 publication date of the canonical SSoT cited for this row (Khinchin *Continued Fractions* 3rd ed., 1964 — earliest English-accessible canonical π CF reference; Russian original 1935).

entered_locally_at.description: Date (UTC) this row was added to the catalog.

notes.description: Free-text notes about the row, e.g. cascade depth used, comparison against the canonical reference, AST-gate confirmation.
